# UrlBuilder.NormalizeSeparators

Kind: Property  
Namespace: `Sisk.Core.Helpers`  
Assembly: `Sisk.Core.dll`  
Source: https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Core.Helpers.UrlBuilder.NormalizeSeparators.html

## NormalizeSeparators {#Sisk_Core_Helpers_UrlBuilder_NormalizeSeparators}

Gets or sets a value indicating whether to normalize separators in the URL.

```csharp
public bool NormalizeSeparators { get; set; }
```

### Property Value

[bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

### Remarks

If [`true`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool), the URL builder will replace backslashes with forward slashes.
